verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions workflows are stored as code in git repos, and GitHub offers CI/CD (github-docs-11) and 'apps, actions' extensibility (github-docs-10), implying version control and rollback via standard git mechanisms. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents workflow versioning, review, or rollback UX for automations (e.g., Actions workflow history, one-click rollback, PR-based review of workflow changes). Missing for 10: explicit docs on Actions workflow version history/diff view, dedicated rollback tooling for automations, and PR review flow specific to workflow files.
